title: Voynich manuscript — Archie
body:
The Whole Manuscript

A grid of all eleven folios of MS 408 across its six sections — herbal, astronomical, balneological, cosmological, pharmaceutical, and recipes — to browse side by side, each readable three ways, with a sounded page.

12 items in this exhibit
f1r — Herbal (opening page)
f18v — Herbal (the sonified folio)
f25v — Herbal
f33v — Herbal
f67r — Astronomical (foldout)
f68r — Astronomical (foldout star-chart)
f75r — Balneological
f78r — Balneological
